senses.gloss: pr. n. (Κύπρος) Cyprus, an island lying off the coast of Phœnicia and Syria.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:6">Y. Succ. R. to I, 16</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:19">IV, 19</cite> (strike out <cite ref="N00280"><he>נהר</he></cite>); v. Graetz Hist. of the Jews, (Jew. Publ. Soc. of A.) II, p. 398.
